title: Stand Up Paddleboard Adventure on the Outer Banks
blurb:
The Kitty Hawk Stand Up Paddle Tour explores the calm bays and sheltered waters of Kitty Hawk, an ideal place to learn how to stand up paddleboard for the first time. This tour leaves standup paddleboarding from our shop in Kitty Hawk and explores the North Carolina Coastal Reserve, one of the few intact maritime forest environments on the Outer Banks. We will also paddle the salt marsh waterways between Martin’s Point and Southern Shores. The Kitty Hawk Stand Up Paddle Tour is just for you.

LOCATION: 6150 North Croatan HWY , Kitty Hawk, NC 27949

1.5 Hour Experience
Quality beginner & intermediate stand up paddleboards
Ideal learning location
Beginner and intermediate SUPs availableAvailable all spring, summer & fall
